notes: GAAP; governmental lines from the Total Governmental Funds column (p4). Taxes 6,460,166 split: General Fund pieces from the General Fund revenue schedule (p10, ties to General Fund taxes 3,844,576); the remaining 2,615,590 (Street 870,100, Debt Service 1,445,490, Other Governmental 300,000) has no tying breakdown and stays Taxes (the Statement of Activities tax lines, p2, do not tie to the fund statement). Intergovernmental Revenues: Homestead and Motor Vehicle Pro-Rate split out using the General Fund schedule (p10). Insurance Proceeds 51,228 under Other Financing Sources on p4 -> other_financing; Bond 18,651 + Loan 56,350 + Capitalized Lease 40,533 proceeds -> debt_proceeds. ending_cash = Cash and Cash Equivalents on the governmental funds Balance Sheet (p3); it also shows Cash with Fiscal Agent 101,405 and Equity in Pooled Cash and Investments 2,178,013. No beginning governmental cash printed. Business-type from the proprietary Statement of Revenues, Expenses and Changes in Net Position (p6): no single total printed, receipts = total operating revenue + interest income, disbursements = total operating expenses + interest expense; transfers in/out 62,883 net 0; Capital Contribution (18,346) as business_type.other_financing. Proprietary cash flows from p7 Total column. Detail: General Fund from the individual revenue and departmental expenditure schedules (pp10-14, department columns), which supersede the General Fund budget columns (p8); Street and Debt Service Funds from the budget schedule (p8, budgetary basis, actual column; Street Federal Receipts has no actual and is omitted); 5 nonmajor funds per fund from the combining statement (p9). Capital Projects Fund (major) has no schedule, so no detail; utility funds have no own schedule in the trim, so no utility detail, as in FY2023/FY2024. Read pages 1-14 of 14
